verdict.rationale: The evidence shows NotebookLM grounds answers in sources the user uploads (PDFs, websites, Docs, Play Books). The only search-related item is a vague "discover new sources" mention, with no documented ability to search scholarly databases or primary-source archives. A community user also reports having to supply URLs or documents manually rather than having the tool search for them, and uploading papers yourself is a user-side workaround that earns no credit.
